headline: CATZOC: How Far Can You Trust Your Chart?
insight: At a charted depth of 20 m, A1 survey data is accurate to about 0.7 m. In zone C the same sounding may be 3 m out. Add that error to your UKC.

sources.title: IHO S-67 Mariners' Guide to Accuracy of Depth Information in ENC

meta.description: CATZOC rates the survey quality behind every part of an electronic chart. What the categories mean for passage planning and under-keel clearance.
meta.question: Do you check CATZOC on every shallow leg?
meta.altText: Maritime term graphic explaining CATZOC, the category of zone of confidence on electronic navigational charts.
